sources.summary: Celebrate the opening of TAELON7: Limbo Engawa and Michael Meredith and Hilary Sample: A Dome with Four Oculi in the Sculpture & Architecture Park at Art Omi on Saturday, September 19, 2–5 PM. Free and open to all ages. RSVP appreciated. Walk-ins always welcome. Opening the afternoon: TAELON7: Limbo Engawa at 2 PM TAELON7: Limbo Engawa marks the Hudson Valley debut of a cross-continental commission between Art Omi and Accra's Limbo Museum.
